Our Journey

25 Years of Grace & Growth

31 October 2001
Trust Founded
Jeevan Jyothy Charitable Trust established in Aryanad, Kerala. Founding Trustees: Rev. Fr. Patrick D'Cruz (President), Very Rev. Msgr. Rufus Pius Lean (Secretary), Rev. Fr. James Culas (Treasurer). A seed of light planted for generations.
2002 – 2003
Education & Boys Home Begin
Boys Home started at Thavanapara (1999), moved to Aryanad 2003 by Piarist Fathers. Maria Rani English school started June 2, 2003 by Oblate Sisters. Seminarian support programme begins (2002).
8 September 2005
Housing Project — Maria Nagar
First 12 houses built & handed over to destitute families. Village named Maria Nagar, blessed by His Excellency Bishop Soosai Packiam, Latin Diocese of Trivandrum — a landmark of charity.
2006
Six More Houses + Centre for Excellence
Sep 8 — Six more houses blessed by Bishop Vincent Samuel. Oct 8 — Jeevan Jyothy Centre for Excellence blessed by Archbishop Soosai Packiam. Monday–Friday boarding for school students.
8 September 2007
Asha Sadan Inaugurated
Home for Aged and Destitute blessed by Bishop Dr. Vincent Samuel, Neyyatinkara Diocese. Entrusted to Adoration Sisters of St. Jerome. Both men (10) and women (20) received shelter.
2008
Leadership Transition
After Rev. Fr. Patrick D'Cruz's passing, Rev. Fr. Nelson Thirunilath joined as Secretary. Rev. Fr. James Culas became President. Very Rev. Msgr. Rufus Pius Lean as Treasurer. Rev. Fr. Joseph Rajesh joined as member.
2010 – 2018
Education at Scale
Up to 500 students received education support. 8 more houses built (2011–2015). Girls Hostel for pharmacy students. Vidhya Jyothy Education Program launched 2014 for Nedumangad Taluk.
2020 – 2022
COVID Service & Seminary Completion
Vidhya Jyothy building offered free to Panchayat for COVID care. Post-COVID, 200 students continue receiving aid. Seminary support concluded after 20 years — ₹1.3 Crore spent for 81 seminarians.
October 2024
Silver Jubilee Law College
16,000 sq.ft building activated for Silver Jubilee Law College, Diocese of Neyyatinkara. Students receive academic aid. Rent of ₹25,000/month funds Asha Sadan inmates.
🎉 2026 — Silver Jubilee
25 Glorious Years of Service
Jeevan Jyothy marks 25 years of transforming lives. Crores of Rupees spent on Education, Housing, Healthcare and Social Welfare. The light shines brighter than ever across Aryanad and beyond.
Activities & Projects

Our Activities in Aryanad

25 years of ground-level transformation through housing, education, elder care, healthcare and social empowerment in Aryanad, Kerala.

Sep 2005 – Present
✦ Housing Project

Maria Nagar Housing Initiative

The Housing Project is the flagship activity of Jeevan Jyothy Charitable Trust. On 8th September 2005, the first 12 houses were built and handed over to destitute families. The village was blessed by His Excellency Bishop Soosai Packiam, Latin Diocese of Trivandrum, and christened "Maria Nagar" — a village born from the spirit of charity.

On September 8, 2006, six more houses were blessed by Bishop Vincent Samuel of the Neyyatinkara Diocese. Between 2011 and 2015, eight more houses were built. Many families in the locality also received partial or complete housing assistance, enabling them to live with dignity.

🏠 26+ Houses Built
📍 Maria Nagar, Aryanad
✝ Bishop-Blessed Village
📅 Since 8 Sep 2005
📚
Education Programme Photos
2003 – Present
✦ Education Project

Education for the Poor — Maria Rani & Beyond

As there were no English medium schools in Aryanad, Maria Rani School was started on 2nd June 2003 by the Oblate Sisters of St. Antony Padua — later becoming Villa Nazareth CBSE School. From 2003, all poor students were given education help. Sponsors from Germany and Italy have been funding their education.

Between 2010 and 2018, up to 500 students were aided annually. Post COVID-19, around 200 students continue to receive regular help. From 2024, students at Silver Jubilee Law College are also supported. ₹30 Lakhs is given every year for education. Over 25 years, crores of rupees have been spent on the education of poor children.

📚 500+ Students Aided
💶 Germany & Italy Sponsors
💰 ₹30L Annual Aid
🏫 Villa Nazareth CBSE School
⚖️ Law College Support 2024
8 Oct 2006
✦ Centre for Excellence

Jeevan Jyothy Centre for Excellence

To help children with English education, the Jeevan Jyothy Centre for Excellence was blessed on 8th October 2006 by the Most Rev. Dr. Soosai Packiam, Archbishop of Trivandrum.

Students of Villa Nazareth School were helped by the Sisters to do their homework at this Centre — students lived in this boarding Monday to Friday. The building was also used for camps and seminars to promote education, culture and social commitments. Students helped by the Trust have completed their studies and are now working and supporting their poor families — a true testament to this Centre's transformative work.

✝ Blessed by Archbishop Soosai Packiam
🏠 Mon–Fri Boarding
🎭 Camps & Seminars
📅 8 Oct 2006
8 Sep 2007
✦ Asha Sadan

Asha Sadan — Home for Aged & Destitute

Asha Sadan Home for Aged and Destitute was blessed on 8th September 2007 by His Excellency Dr. Vincent Samuel, Bishop of Neyyatinkara Diocese, and entrusted to the Adoration Sisters of St. Jerome. The home has capacity for thirty inmates.

For the first ten years, both men and women — 10 poor men and 20 poor women — were given shelter. Later, as government regulations did not allow both under the same building, men's admission was stopped. During and after COVID-19, many inmates passed away. At present, 10 women reside here. The rent from Silver Jubilee Law College (₹25,000/month) funds this home.

👴 Capacity: 30 Inmates
👩‍🦳 10 Women Currently
✝ Adoration Sisters of St. Jerome
📅 8 Sep 2007

Seminary Photos
2002 – 2022
✦ Seminary Formation

Help for Seminarians

From 2002 till 2022, Jeevan Jyothy Charitable Trust generously supported the spiritual and academic formation of seminarians. The Trust helped 70 seminarians of the Diocese of Neyyatinkara and 11 seminarians of the Archdiocese of Trivandrum — a total of 81 seminarians.

An approximate amount of One Crore and Thirty Thousand Rupees (₹1,30,00,000) was spent on this project over 20 years — investing in the future shepherds of God's people. This contribution ensured that many devoted young men from modest backgrounds could complete their priestly formation without financial anxiety.

✝ 70 Neyyatinkara Seminarians
⛪ 11 Trivandrum Seminarians
💰 ₹1 Crore 30 Thousand
📅 2002 – 2022 (20 Years)

Medical Aid Photos
Ongoing
✦ Medical Aid

Medical Assistance Programme

Medical assistance has been a consistent thread through Jeevan Jyothy's 25 years of service. The Trust has extended significant financial help for major medical procedures including kidney transplantation, dialysis and heart operations — enabling life-saving treatment for those who could not otherwise afford it.

Looking ahead, the 16,000 sq.ft building — currently hosting Silver Jubilee Law College — has the potential to be converted into a hospital, addressing the critical need for a major medical facility in Aryanad, where no big hospital currently exists.

🫀 Heart Operations Funded
🧪 Kidney Transplants
💉 Dialysis Support
🏥 Potential Hospital — 16,000 sq.ft
⚖️
Law College Photos
Oct 2024
✦ Legal Education

Silver Jubilee Law College

In 2023, a building of 16,000 sq.ft — near Mount Carmel Forane Church, Aryanad — was availed for the Diocese of Neyyatinkara at a minimum rent of just ₹5,000 per month. The college was officially started in October 2024, and the rent was later revised to ₹25,000 per month.

This rental income is channelled entirely towards the care of inmates of Asha Sadan Home — a beautiful cycle where education sustains elder care. From 2024, students of this college also receive academic support from the Trust. Managed by Very Rev. Msgr. Rufus Pius Lean.

🏢 16,000 sq.ft Building
📅 Started: October 2024
⚖️ Diocese of Neyyatinkara
💰 Rent Funds Asha Sadan

Boys Home Photos
1999 – 2013
✦ Boys Residential Home

Boys Home — Aryanad

The Boys Home started at Thavanapara in 1999 and moved to Aryanad in 2003. A property of 1 acre 62 cents was given to the Piarist Fathers in 2002 to build and run the home for students of 8th, 9th and 10th standard.

The home continued until 2013 when the Piarist Fathers wanted to start a school. The Trust gave 5 acres and 25 cents of land to the Piarist Fathers for the school, in exchange for the Boys Home land (1.62 acres). Students from the Boys Home are today well placed in society, supporting their poor families — a true success story of social investment.

👦 8th–10th Standard Boys
📍 Thavanapara→Aryanad
🏫 Piarist Fathers
🌟 Alumni Supporting Families

Vidhya Jyothy Photos
2014 – Present
✦ Vidhya Jyothy

Vidhya Jyothy Education Programme

Nedumangad Taluk is marked as a backward taluk in education, health and social life in Kerala. From 2014, students from 4th Standard were given special education — improving Malayalam, English, Hindi and Mathematics.

Monthly weekend training for English — covering Reading, Writing, Listening and Speaking — was held at the Vidhya Jyothy building (formerly St. Joseph's Hostel). During COVID-19, the building was offered free of cost to the Panchayat for caring for COVID-affected patients — an act of selfless community service.

📖 4th Standard Students
🗣 English: RWLS
📐 Mal · Eng · Hindi · Maths
🏥 COVID Relief Centre (Free)
🏢
Hostel Photos
Former Activity
✦ Girls Hostel

Hostel for Girls — Pharmacy Students

A building of 16,000 sq.ft was purchased from the Piarist Fathers — close to Mount Carmel Forane Church, Aryanad — in exchange for 5 acres and 25 cents of land. A Girls Hostel was started in this building for pharmacy students.

As student numbers increased, hostel operations were shifted to the Jeevan Jyothy Centre for Excellence building. The original building later became the premises for Silver Jubilee Law College — demonstrating the Trust's ability to repurpose assets to serve evolving community needs.

🏢 16,000 sq.ft Building

About

About Jeevan Jyothy

✦ Aims & Objects of the Trust

As enshrined in the Trust Deed

1

Charitable and social services to any person in need irrespective of caste, creed, religion or nationality.

2

Promotion of learning and culture at all levels by schools, reading rooms, libraries, audio visual units etc.

3

Undertake development activities such as building houses and start educational scholarships etc for the care and welfare of the poor people.

4

Start Educational Institutions, such as professional Colleges, Technical/Higher Secondary Schools, Para-medical Institutions etc.

5

Conduct classes, studies, seminars, conferences and meetings with the view to educate children, youth, women and underprivileged.

6

Form and maintain personal requirements to carry out the aim and objectives of the trust by means of residence and boarding houses.

7

Promote, maintain and network inter-religious neighbourhood communities to ensure the integral welfare of the poor and needy.

8

Acquire, possess, administer and sell movable and immovable property to the extent that it may support the objectives of the Trust.

9

Establish funds, accept donations of any kind useful to the attainment of the aims and objectives of the Trust.

10

Charitable relief activities including medical aid, helping the victims of flood, drought and other natural calamities.

11

Providing financial assistance to education, health care, housing and marriage expenses for the socially and economically backward classes, and to any institution or community centres.

12

Such other things that are necessary and conducive to the attainment of all or any of the above objects.

The Story of Jeevan Jyothy

Jeevan Jyothy Charitable Trust was founded on 31st October 2001 in Aryanad — a village in the backward Nedumangad Taluk of Kerala. The name "Jeevan Jyothy" means "Light of Life" — a name that beautifully captures the Trust's mission of bringing hope and dignity to the lives of the poor and marginalised.

Rooted in Christian charity and driven by deep compassion, the Trust was established to serve the most vulnerable — the destitute, the homeless, the elderly, the sick, and children without access to quality education. From its very first year, the Trust began reaching out to families in need, building homes, funding education and supporting the formation of future priests.

Over 25 glorious years, Jeevan Jyothy has built 26+ homes in Maria Nagar, funded the education of 500+ students, supported 81 seminarians with ₹1.3 Crore, sheltered 30+ elderly persons in Asha Sadan, provided life-saving medical aid, and established the Silver Jubilee Law College for the Diocese of Neyyatinkara. International partnerships with sponsors from Germany and Italy have amplified the Trust's reach significantly. In 2026, we joyfully celebrate the Silver Jubilee — 25 years of light, hope, and transformation.

A Life Devoted to Service & Faith

Very Rev. Msgr. Rufus Pius Lean is a distinguished diocesan priest of the Diocese of Neyyattinkara, Kerala. Born on 5th May 1951 and ordained to the holy priesthood on 19th December 1974, he has dedicated over five decades of his life to the service of God and His people.

He currently serves as Diocesan Co-Ordinator for Ministries, as Parish Priest of Christ the King Forane Church, Nedumangad, and as Manager of Silver Jubilee Law College — carrying forward his lifelong dedication to pastoral leadership, education, and service to the Diocese.

Msgr. Lean is closely associated with Asha Sadan and the Jeevan Jyothy Centre for Excellence — both in Aryanad — institutions that reflect his deep commitment to education, social welfare and spiritual formation. He resides at La Providence, Maria Nagar, Aryanad, Kerala 695542.

His priestly motto embraced at ordination: "Give me the strength to make my love fruitful in service." — a motto he has lived with extraordinary fidelity for over 51 years.

On the occasion of his 75th Birthday in May 2026, the faithful gathered in joyful celebration to honour a life richly lived in faith, humility and priestly dedication.

  • 2007–Present

  • Elevation

  • 2024
    Manager, Silver Jubilee Law College — Appointed to manage Silver Jubilee Law College for the Diocese of Neyyatinkara — continuing his commitment to education and service.
  • 5 May 2026
    75th Birthday Celebration — A jubilant celebration of 75 years of life, honouring a priest whose faith, wisdom and gentle spirit have touched countless hearts across Kerala and beyond.
